Type one ticker, or several separated by commas to rotate them, or to fill a heatmap below.
Heatmap Grid shows every symbol above as one color-coded grid instead of rotating through them. Timeframe, company name, sparkline, 52-week range, holdings and alerts below don't apply in this mode.
Adds a bar showing where today's price sits between its 52-week low and high. Uses your Finnhub key; refreshes every 30 minutes.
Holdings (optional)
Fill both to show your position's profit/loss on the key.
Alerts (optional)
The key shows a colored ring when the price crosses a threshold.
Account
Get your FREE key (no credit card):
1. Go to finnhub.io and sign up free.
2. Verify your email; it signs you into your dashboard.
3. Copy the API key shown there and paste it above.
Enter it once; it is saved for every stock key. Press a key to cycle timeframe.
